rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — four done sections (§16, §21, §27, §28) cite their gate log as docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/s16.html, s21.html, s27.html and s28.html, and none of the four files exists; every other anchor checked resolves, including the extensionless /reckon/ hrefs, tests/test_the_reflex_resumes_an_unpromoted_run.py, the cited commits and the cited sections of the sibling plans.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — each live section (§3, §29, §31) states a measurable check with a declared negative control, and every completed section's done-when names one too; the base-revision controls are named per section.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — gate logs and censuses are addressed under docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/ or ~/.cache/reckon-suite-at-head/, both durable and openable; none names a node-local temporary directory.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the plan text uses the product's own vocabulary (crew ack, promotion-requested, commits:) and asks no code symbol to carry a plan label, stage name or ticket number.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — §29's cited measurement reconciles exactly with the log it names (1,037 failed, 21,127 passed, 41 errors, and 393 distinct files red at 8d50b0333f), §31's stated root cause matches the store's structure (station_obligations.py:174 keys the stored sweep failure by session and _with_sweep_failures at :214 raises it into that session's payload), and no section prescribes a code path, step sequence or function to call.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — each node carries one endpoint (a batch entry's field set, one red test file, one obligation-ownership rule); the multi-bullet done-whens are checks of a single endpoint rather than separate deliverables.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — the plan's only open followup (f-qwnw-001, plan.html:347) still instructs queueing §2–§16 and §19–§25 while §29 and §31 are declared implementable and named nowhere in it.
